artworks.title: Title Page for "Il Solimano"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.7 × 14 cm (7 3/4 × 5 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a costumed figure holding a shield with text, situated between ornate pillars. The central figure wears an elaborate headdress and flowing robes, holding a staff in one hand and a shield with text in the other. Flanking the figure are two grand columns adorned with intricate carvings and decorative ornaments. The background shows a distant landscape with delicate engravings, hinting at a bustling scene. Above the figure is a heraldic emblem with a crown and a Latin inscription. The artwork features fine lines, detailed shading, and a focus on architectural and costume details, evoking a sense of grandeur and theatricality reminiscent of historical and classical themes.

artworks.title: The Slave Market
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy street scene with architectural structures and various figures. It depicts a large open area bordered by a grand building to the left and a rounded tower or structure to the right. The left side of the scene is lined with stairs leading up to an elevated walkway or platform, where people are gathered. In the middle and to the right, a crowd has formed, encompassing the space in front of the tower. Various individuals, some wearing distinctive headgear, are seen mingling and gesturing. The architectural details in the background, such as the windows and brickwork of the tower, frame the scene below. A hand-operated apparatus extends from the tower, possibly for lifting goods or supplies. The drawing captures a dynamic urban moment.

artworks.title: The Slave Market
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a town square or market area bustling with people. The scene includes buildings, a river or canal, a bridge with people and boats, and distant structures like towers and a church spire. The etching style features fine lines detailing the architecture and figures. Close-up groups of figures engage in different activities, wearing textured clothing. The overall color palette is black and white.

artworks.title: The True Effigy of Saint Francis
artworks.medium: etching with some engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 6.7 × 4.2 cm (2 5/8 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person's body. The individual is positioned facing slightly to the left, with their head turned to look directly at the viewer. The person's facial features include a solemn expression with deep-set eyes and a beard. They have a hood over their head, with their hair not visible beneath it. The person is wearing a robe, typical of monastic attire, which covers their shoulders and chest. In their right hand, they hold a closed book, and their left hand is raised, fingers extended in a gesture. The background is filled with radiating lines, and ornate decorative scrolling borders surround the image. The text below reads "Vera SS. Francisci Effigies."

artworks.title: The Miracle of Saint Mansuy
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in various outfits. In the center, a man with a crown and a scepter is surrounded by clerics and individuals in historic attire. A person is seen kneeling nearby. On the left, a group of diverse figures observes the scene, while on the right, a partially dressed figure is seated or collapsed. The background includes buildings, a landscape, and a cloudy sky. The scene is detailed and intricate.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for the "Statutes of the Order of the Knights of Saint Stephen"
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring an elaborate allegorical and heraldic design. The central figure is a standing female clad in classical armor, holding a flag and standing on a pedestal. Flanking her are two seated female figures in classical attire, one holding a sword and scales, the other an open book. Below the central figure is an ornate cartouche with Italian text concerning the statutes of an order dedicated to Grand Duke Cosimo II. Surrounding the base are two figures, one a soldier and the other depicted with symbols of maritime authority such as ships or cannons. The composition is rich with symbolism related to law, governance, and military strength.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Balli di Sfessania"
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical performance featuring masked characters. The scene depicts three central figures engaged in an interaction. The figure on the left is holding a musical instrument, while adopting a dynamic pose. The central figure is holding a tambourine high above their head and is in mid-step. The figure on the right is playing a stringed instrument. Behind these figures, a backdrop of curtains and partial faces peeking out from between the curtains add depth to the setting. The image showcases rich detailing, including ornate costumes with pointed hats and elaborate masks.

artworks.title: Cucorongna and Pernoualla
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fantastical creatures in a dramatic pose. The drawing portrays two peculiar, human-like figures with exaggerated, dynamic gestures. On the left, a creature labeled "Cucorongna" is depicted in an assertive stance, with a large feathered hat, a cape, and an almost skeletal physique. To the right, another figure labeled "Pernoualla" mirrors the first, with similar attire and posture. The scene is set against a rustic backdrop with small groups of figures and structures reminiscent of an ancient or mythical setting. The composition is executed with fine, fluid lines that capture the sense of movement and character.

artworks.title: Cap. Cerimonia and Siga. Lavinia
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fantastical figures in an outdoor setting. The figure on the left is labeled as "Cap. Cerimonia," and is depicted with human-like legs and arms, a buttoned outfit, a bird-like mask, and long pointed ears or hair extensions. The figure on the right is labeled as "Sig.a Lavinia," wearing an elegant gown and a feathered hat. In the background, there are groups of smaller figures engaged in various activities or socializing, with buildings and trees in the background. The drawing uses fine linework and shading to create a whimsical and theatrical scene.

artworks.title: Cicho Sgarra and Collo Francisco
artworks.description: The image shows two fantastical figures in a procession. The figures are humanoid creatures with bird-like faces and elongated limbs. One figure on the left holds a dagger in its left hand, while the other on the right carries a weapon at the waist. Both wear flowing garments resembling wings. In the background, a crowd of similar creatures follows, with buildings sketched faintly. The names "Cicho Sgarra" and "Collo Francisco" are written beneath the figures.

artworks.title: Gian Fritello and Ciurlo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two surreal figures with animal features. It depicts two humanoid creatures with elongated features and bird-like characteristics. One figure, titled "Gian Fritello," stands upright holding a sword and wearing a feathered headdress. The other figure, named "Ciurlo," is in an animated pose with a raised arm and a sword, also wearing a feathered headdress. The background features smaller figures engaged in various activities, possibly fighting or dancing. The illustration is done in a monochromatic ink style resembling early engraving or woodcut techniques, capturing movement and character through fluid lines and minimal detailing.

artworks.title: Guatsetto and Mestolino
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two masked and cloaked characters standing on either side of a scene involving various mysterious figures in the background. The central figures, labeled "Guatsetto" and "Mestolino," have exaggerated features, such as long noses and oversized hats adorned with long feathers. They hold swords in a non-menacing posture. In the background, smaller figures are engaged in what seems to be a dance or performance, with one figure appearing to leap into the air. The scene exudes a playful and surreal atmosphere, characteristic of a comical pantomime or carnival. The fine, detailed lines suggest this is an etching or pen illustration capturing the lively essence of a bygone festivity or theatrical performance.

artworks.title: Riciulina and Metzetin
artworks.description: The image features two figures in full body view against a simple background. The person on the left, "Riculina," is in a dancing pose with raised arms, detailed facial expression, ornate clothing, and a feathered headdress. The person on the right, "Metzetin," is also dancing, holding a guitar-like instrument and wearing a feathered hat and a long flowing garment with broad sleeves. In the background, there are people watching the performance, with distant buildings and sparse trees.

artworks.title: Pulliciniello and Siga. Lucretia
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing side by side, identified as Pulliciniello and Sigra. Lucretia. Pulliciniello is on the left, slightly turned to the right and holding hands with Sigra. Lucretia. He has a hooked nose, a curved mustache, and wears a long-sleeved garment, pointed shoes, and a draped cape. Sigra. Lucretia is on the right, facing forward with her left hand on her hip and extending her other arm to hold Pulliciniello's hand. She has styled hair with curls, wearing a long dress with balloon sleeves and a cinched waist. The background shows a townscape with small houses and figures in motion, some carrying swords.

artworks.title: Cap. Spessa Monti and Bagattino
artworks.description: The image shows two exaggerated characters, named "Cap. Spessa Monti" and "BaGattino," engaged in a theatrical performance on a street. Both figures are dressed in theatrical costumes with oversized features, such as long noses and exaggerated clothing. One of the figures appears to be wielding a sword. In the background, there are other exaggerated figures and a few buildings, creating an outdoor public scene. The comic style hints at a narrative or parody, showcasing a lively and humorous aspect of street performance or comedic theater.

artworks.title: Cap. Bonbardon and Cap. Grillo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two masked figures in a theatrical confrontation. The drawing depicts two exaggerated, cartoonish characters named "Cap. Bonbardon" and "Cap. Grillo." They are dressed in flamboyant costumes typical of the commedia dell'arte style, with each figure striking a dramatic pose. In the background, there are groups of smaller figures observing or partaking in an implied performance; they are dressed in cloaks and hats, with some holding batons or trumpets. The scene is set in an outdoor environment, with minimalistic lines suggesting the presence of trees and buildings.

artworks.title: Cap. Esgangarato and Cap. Cocodrillo
artworks.description: The image depicts two human-like figures with elongated limbs and exaggerated postures, creating dynamic and twisted lines that converge into an abstract design. The figures appear to be engaged in a theatrical or dance-like pose, reminiscent of marionettes or puppets with exaggerated features. In the background, small figures gather as if witnessing a performance, while a sparse landscape with trees and a building suggests an outdoor setting. The illustration merges fantastical elements with the semblance of a stage performance.

artworks.title: Cap. Mala Gamba and Cap. Bellavita
artworks.description: Two large, burly figures are depicted on a stage-like setting. The figures are labeled "Cap. Mala Gamba" and "Cap. Bellauita" and are wearing exaggerated, ornate clothing reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque period costumes. Their outfits include large, puffy sleeves and leg garments adorned with buttons and detailing, with each figure donning a feathered cap. The figures are in dramatic poses, with one seemingly wielding a fencing foil while the other gestures with an exaggerated hand movement. Smaller figures can be seen in the background observing, suggesting they are performers. Sparse trees and structures frame the scene, possibly indicating an outdoor setting. The drawing style is reminiscent of 17th-century illustrations, with detailed line work and an expressive rendering of figures.

artworks.title: Cap. Babeo and Cucuba
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two costumed figures titled 'Cap. Baboe' and 'Cucuba' in a street setting. In the drawing, they are facing off in a wide street scene with buildings and onlookers in the background. The figure on the left, labeled "Cap. Baboe," wears a large feathered hat, a long coat adorned with buttons, and holds a sword. The figure on the right, labeled "Cucuba," is in a dynamic pose with arms raised, a feather extending from their hat, and holding a stick. Their clothing is loose and tied at the waist, with an expressive stance suggesting intense action or drama. In the background, there are small crowds and a horse-drawn cart, creating a lively street atmosphere. The figures have exaggerated features and costumes, implying a satirical or theatrical element reminiscent of comedic or carnival street performances.

artworks.title: Fracischina and Gian Farina
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in full-body view, both positioned in an expressive, animated stance. The figure on the left is a woman named Fracischina, who is raising a tambourine above her head with both hands. She has curly hair and wears a long dress with billowing sleeves and a sash tied around the waist. The figure on the right is a man named Gian Farina, holding a sword aloft in one hand, while the other hand holds fabric in the form of a cape or article of clothing. His body appears to lean backward. He wears a hat, loose-fitting clothing, and matching footwear. The background depicts a scene of people in an outdoor setting, possibly a market or town square with several individuals gathered around, including a person doing a handstand.

artworks.title: Razullo and Cucurucu
artworks.description: This is an illustration depicting two costumed characters performing a scene. The character on the left, identified as "Razullo," holds a long object, potentially an instrument, towards the other character, labeled "Cucurucu." Cucurucu is shown in a dramatic pose with raised arms and spread legs. Both characters wear detailed, feathered headpieces and textured clothing. In the background, a crowd is gathered in front of architectural structures resembling a town square or stage set. The illustration portrays a theatrical moment with a focus on the characters' gestures and attire.

artworks.title: Pasquariello Truonno and Meo Squaquara
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two anthropomorphic figures wearing exaggerated masks and costumes. The figures dominate the foreground, displaying dynamic postures suggestive of movement. Each character is adorned with large buttons running down the center of their body, a pair of swords at their waist, and a flowing cape. Their facial features are exaggerated and mask-like. In the background, several smaller figures are engaged in various activities, set against a sparse landscape with a wind-swept tree and distant architectural structures.

artworks.title: Signa. Lucia and Trastullo
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals: a woman named Sig. Lucia standing on the left, and a man named Trasfullo kneeling on the right. Sig. Lucia stands upright in a long dress with puffed sleeves, while Trasfullo kneels and reaches up towards her, holding onto a cloth or sash that she is also holding. Trasfullo wears loose-fitting clothing and a cap. The background shows a street scene with buildings and small groups of people interacting. The artwork is done in a classical etching style.

artworks.title: Cap. Cardoni and Maramao
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fictional characters in a dynamic pose. The image depicts two exaggerated figures standing opposite each other. The figure on the left is titled "Cap. Cardoni" and appears to have elongated features, holding a staff or sword towards the ground. The figure on the right, "Maramao," is also exaggerated, bending forward with a stick aimed at "Cap. Cardoni." Both characters have elongated limbs and comic expressions. The scene is set in a town square with other figures in the background engaged in various activities, with architectural elements in the backdrop.
